name: ir_get_all_resources
description:
One-call overview of a supported company's investor relations material: IR page, recent annual reports, latest earnings and presentations.
Returns {ticker, ir_page, annual_reports: {count, annual_reports (up to 3)}, latest_earnings: {latest_earnings, previous_earnings}, presentations: {count, presentations (up to 5)}, success}; documents have the shape {title, url, type, year, quarter, date, description, ticker, is_pdf, context}.
Inputs (* required): ticker* (string, stock symbol such as AAPL or MSFT; case-insensitive).
Scrapes the company's IR site; falls back to SEC EDGAR filings when that finds nothing and a CIK is known. Only tickers in SAJHA's built-in company list work (ir_list_supported_companies); others fail with 'not supported'. It scrapes several pages, so it is slower than the single-purpose ir_* tools.
Example: {"ticker": "AAPL"}
